# Highland Village Laundry

> Big-load self-service laundromat based in Bloomington, Indiana. Washers from 30 to 80 lb, fast dryers and an attendant on site, on S Curry Pike. Bring the comforters, the sleeping bags and the whole week's laundry.

## Services
- Big-load washers: Dexter Express front-loaders in 30, 40, 50, 60 and 80 lb sizes. Comforters, sleeping bags and blankets fit with room to spare.
- Fast dryers: Big stacked dryers that get thick bedding dry quickly. One regular dried a thick queen comforter on a few quarters.
- Soap, change & snacks: Forgot something? The soap center, change machines, ATM and vending machines have you covered.

## About
Highland Village Laundry is a self-service laundromat at 350 S Curry Pike on Bloomington's west side, under the red-lettered sign and the copper roof. It's built for big loads: rows of Dexter Express washers from 30 up to 80 lb, big stacked dryers, long folding tables, a soap center, change machines and an ATM. An attendant is on site, tidying up and helping when a machine acts up. Regulars say it plainly. It's clean, there's lots of hot water, and the dryers are fast. Some drive across town just to do their laundry here.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Highland Village Laundry is open every day, 6 AM to 8 PM. Call (812) 287-7144 if you're cutting it close.
- Q: What size washers do you have?
  A: Dexter Express front-loaders in 30, 40, 50, 60 and 80 lb sizes. The big ones handle comforters, sleeping bags and several loads at once.
- Q: How do I pay?
  A: The washers and dryers are quarters only. Three change machines and an ATM are inside, so you can get quarters on the spot.
- Q: Can I wash a king comforter or sleeping bags?
  A: Yes. That's what the big machines are for. One customer washed three sleeping bags, a queen comforter and four throw blankets in one visit.
- Q: Do I need to bring detergent?
  A: No. The soap center sells single packs of detergent, bleach, softener and dryer sheets, plus laundry bags, for $1.25 each (five quarters).
- Q: Is someone there to help?
  A: Yes. An attendant is on site and will help if a machine gives you trouble.
